Your clipboard in your AI assistant, and what you copied when you paste files.

- **Your clipboard, in your AI assistant.** Connect Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, VS Code or another MCP assistant: it can search your history, read a copy, put text on your clipboard, save a snippet or set a favorite. Off by default and local to this Mac. Settings → MCP gives you the setup to copy for each one.
- **You stay in control.** Detected secrets stay hidden from assistants unless you allow access, and Settings show the last 200 calls, without clipboard content. What your assistant reads then follows its own data rules.
- **Paste what you copied.** Paste copied files into a document and you get their text and images, up to 25 MB in all, while the Finder and attachments still get the files.
- **How it works.** A [new page of the site](https://kamasoutra.github.io/encore/how-it-works/) maps all of encore's code and walks through what happens when you copy, paste or share, step by step, down to each file on GitHub.
- **Several files, one copy.** The card says how many files a copy holds, the Space preview and the compact window show them all, and a drag takes them all.
- **Fixed.** New screenshots reach your history even when Spotlight has stopped indexing your Mac. An assistant reconnects when encore restarts.

Download the ZIP, unzip, and move Encore.app to Applications. SHA256SUMS contains its checksum. Installed copies update themselves.

encore is not notarized yet. [Apple's first-launch instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445). History encryption is optional and off by default; exports are not encrypted; files are references; embedded payloads are limited to 25 MiB.
